svg.text: Top (A, 8 whole weeks, no window): sharp lines at 1, 2, 3, 4 per day and, beside each, sidebands at k ± 1/7, 2/7, 3/7: the weekly envelope moved up to every daily harmonic (the
modulation theorem). B (Hann window): the same lines with the floor between them pushed down; the price is lines twice as wide. C (one week): the record is too short to
separate lines 1/7 per day apart (resolution 1/T), so carrier and sidebands melt into one broad hump. Hover for the period in hours.
